sections.title: Start from Home
sections.text: To assign a workout program, open the menu.

sections.title: Pick a Program
sections.text: Choose Pick a Program to browse your options.

sections.title: Choose a training style
sections.text: Choose a training style that fits your goals and schedule.

sections.title: Compare the routines
sections.text: Compare the routines, then open Details for a closer look.

sections.title: Review the program
sections.text: Review the experience level, training cycle, and how the program progresses.

sections.title: Assign to me
sections.text: Tap Assign to me when you've found the right fit.

sections.title: Choose your start date
sections.text: Choose Today, Tomorrow, or Next Monday as your start date.

sections.title: Confirm your selection
sections.text: Tap Assign to save your start date.

sections.title: Your program is assigned
sections.text: Already Assigned confirms your selection and prevents duplicate assignments.

sections.title: Return to Home
sections.text: Use the back arrow to return to Home.

sections.title: Your plan, on your dashboard
sections.text: Today's training now follows your program, with a preview and a button to start.
